title: Before a child repo switches to the map skill at @stable, its map-check passes on stable's skill
why: Lane merge-flow-after-anthropic found that a child pinning the map skill at @stable meets format drift as stable moves. Banchi's `make map-check` is red on the switch: the old pin read format 5, stable's skill reads 6, and bumping to 6 gives MAP1 and MAP10.
source: Coordinator 21:12 CST Nov 13, from the lane's measurement (lane clock 21:14); triage has measured nothing.
note: Triage 21:14 CST Nov 13: home, mailaudit and q_max pass (lane report). Child draft PRs: home #728 (c63fad1b5940), mailaudit #324 (b359fda8c490), banchi #1098 (9e33a74b493f), q_max #1171 (21309ddf98b7, five owed items building); all draft, tests being re-pointed. Fix: a check, before each child switches, that its map-check passes on stable's skill; red case first. Coordinator pick, undoable (undo: close the draft): the lane builds a banchi map-format-6 draft PR under #1098, docs lines only. Triage agrees; it keeps behaviour and widens no shared tool.
